{{Quote|Why are you here? Why have you attacked this city?''"<br />"''To prove a point. As long as just one Imperial lives, so does the ''Empire''.|Wedge Antilles and Weir's aide|<ref name="X-Wing: Rogue Leader 2">[[X-Wing: Rogue Leader 2|''X-Wing: Rogue Leader'' 2]]</ref>}}
'''Weir's aide''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as an aide to [[General/Legends|General]] [[Weir/Legends|Weir]].

==Biography==
Weir's aide was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] officer who served [[Storm commando/Legends|Storm Commando]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Weir/Legends|Weir]] as an aide in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]. When, after the [[Death Star II/Legends|Death Star II's]] destruction, Weir launched a terror attack on [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]], [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] to remind the populace of the Empire's control, his aide was with him. [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] captured the aide, who explained the purpose of the attack. Antilles and his companions abandoned the aide to pursue Weir, who departed after feeling his mission was complete, leaving the aide behind.
